messages:
Zoe (CS): Quick recap from Aukland private-VPC dry run this morning. We hit three blockers: CIDR overlap with their datacenter, CMK refusing Decrypt for our service, and audit-forward to their Elastic endpoint returning 403. They flagged this as a potential renewal risk. Need owners and P0 triage.
Pablo (Network): Can you paste the CIDR they selected? I want to model overlap and propose a carve or transit path.
Zoe (CS): They insisted on 100.80.0.0/16 (their on-prem VPN uses 100.80.0.0/16). They say they cannot renumber before their carrier maintenance window in Q3.
Pablo (Network): If renumbering is off the table, immediate options are: 1) carve non-overlapping ranges on our side + BGP/static routing, 2) deploy a small NAT/proxy bridge in a management VPC (fastest), or 3) Transit Gateway with route segregation (cleaner long-term). Proxy adds an extra hop and egress cost. I'll sketch latency and cost.
Mina (Security): KMS detail: customer-provided CMK returns "AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt" when our job attempts decrypt. They supplied a role arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/Aukland-Redwood-Bridge but its trust policy only allows their CI principal. We need them to add our service role to the trust policy and add a key-policy statement granting kms:Decrypt to the assumed role.
Zoe (CS): @Mina can you paste the minimal trust policy snippet we can send to Aukland?
Mina (Security): Minimal trust policy to paste (replace REDWOOD_ROLE with our service role ARN):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```
Mina (Security): Also the CMK key policy must include a statement that grants "kms:Decrypt" to the role ARN above (the assumed role), not to account root. I'll add the exact key-policy snippet into the ticket.
logbot: Forward attempt 2026-05-12T10:18Z to Aukland Elastic ingest returned 403 Forbidden. Response: {"error":"forbidden","reason":"invalid-credentials"}. Forwarder role: arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/Aukland-LogPush. See /var/log/forwarder/aukland-2026-05-12.log
Zoe (CS): They rotated ingest credentials overnight; likely misconfigured on their side. Also check the forwarder role permissions: should allow elastic:ESHttpPut/ESHttpPost scoped to their ingest endpoint.
Pablo (Network): For the CIDR workaround, I can prototype a proxy NAT pair in our mgmt VPC within a day and provide a rollback plan. Transit GW will take more coord but I'd recommend it for scale. Will upload a short doc with expected latency (approx +7-12ms) and estimated monthly cost.
Zoe (CS): Aukland marked this as a blocker for the renewal discussion next Tuesday. Can we mark P0 and hold an internal triage today 16:00 PT? Evan (CS Lead) wants legal context on contractual guarantees.
infra-bot: Ticket created: CUST-43110 "Aukland priv-VPC blockers: CIDR/KMS/audit" assigned to Pablo and Mina. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CUST-43110
Pablo (Network): Assigned. I'll add network diagrams and the proxy runbook to CUST-43110 by EOD.
Mina (Security): I'll paste the IAM trust and CMK key-policy snippets plus a small verification checklist: 1) perform sts:AssumeRole smoke test, 2) run a kms:Decrypt test, 3) forwarder ingest smoke to Elastic (with test token).
Evan (CS Lead): On calendar for 16:00 PT. I'll bring renewal/legal notes and a short script for the customer update. Zoe, please draft the customer-facing status after the triage with owners, ETA, and possible impacts on latency/cost.
Aukland (customer): We can update the role trust this afternoon and re-run the ingest test at 14:00 PT. If the proxy is needed, what is the expected cutover window?
Pablo (Network): If we go proxy route, cutover could be as short as 30-60 minutes (we'll need a maintenance window for IP rewrite and verification). I'll include cutover and rollback steps in the runbook.
Zoe (CS): Thanks team. Action items: Pablo upload runbook + cost/latency; Mina upload IAM/CMK snippets and verification checklist; Evan to coordinate legal/renewal context. We'll confirm after the 16:00 PT sync and send Aukland a clear next-step note. :thumbsup:
